escape_ids: escape IDs and names in Croissant by replacing special characters and ensuring uniqueness against existing IDs
get_record_set: get a unique record set name for a dataset config by prefixing with record_set_ when dataset and config names match
truncate_features_from_croissant_crumbs_: truncate features from a croissant crumbs response to avoid returning more than 1000 columns
escape_jsonpath_key: escape single quotes and brackets in a feature name to produce a valid JSONPath key string
feature_to_croissant_field: convert a Hugging Face Datasets feature like Value Image Audio or Video to a Croissant field dictionary
